name: תְּחִנָּה
summary: The noun תְּחִנָּה, “supplication” or “favour”. Tehinnah son of Eshton, “the father of Ir-nahash”, among the men of Recah in the line of Judah (1Ch 4:12).

evidence.note: “Eshton fathered Beth-rapha and Paseah and תְּחִנָּה the father of Ir-nahash.”
The noun: “turn to the prayer of your servant and to his supplication (תְּחִנָּתוֹ)”.
The noun as favour shown: “for a little moment favour (תְחִנָּה) has been shown from Yahweh our God”.

note: Takes h.dz.ar. The database files under it, by spelling, three tokens of the noun (Jos 11:20; 1Ki 8:38; 2Ch 6:29); only 1Ch 4:12 is the name.
